lines.text: David cries for God to save him because the waters are up to his neck, and his throat is parched.
David has become a stranger to his brothers because zeal for God's house has consumed him.
David wept and fasted and made sackcloth his clothing, and those who sit at the gate mock him.
Insults broke David's heart, and he found no comforters, and they gave him wine to quench his thirst.
God will save Bethel and rebuild the cities of Judah, and the descendants of His servants will inherit it.
